localityOverviewData.dotcomLocalityDesc:
Whitefield/ Bangalore is located in the eastern periphery of Bangalore city. The growth story of this Whitefield area started in the late 1990s during the IT boom. It was an outlying area to Bangalore city back then. It is a significant part of the city as it houses innumerable residential, commercial and business complexes. 

Connecting Whitefield with Bangalore city are the two four-lane roads. One is via Mahadevapura, and the other is via Marathahalli. It is in the vicinity of the other significant areas of the city like Hoodi, KR Puram, Brookefield, and Marathahalli. 

Whitefield is home to research centres, hospitals, malls, schools, IT offices and many other facilities to cater to all the sections of people living in the area, meaning that your place of work and your place of stay could be nearby. 

All prominent realtors like Prestige, Shoba, Shriram Group, Godrej Properties, Divya Shree, and Brigade offer residential and commercial spaces in Whitefield. Numerable new projects are under the pipeline.

Being a notably luxurious locality, Whitefield houses about 46% of villa properties. Among apartments, 2 BHK configurations are the hot favourite. About 61% of the properties are in this configuration. About 47% of the properties lie in the price range of Rs. 40 lakhs to Rs. 60 lakhs, 11% in the price range of Rs. 60 lakhs to Rs. 80 lakhs and the other 42% cost more than Rs. 80 lakhs.

developer.description:
The Prestige Group is one of the foremost names when it comes to Indian real estate and was founded in the year 1986. Prestige Builders has a significant presence in cities like Bangalore, Chennai, Kochi, Hyderabad, Goa and Mangalore. The portfolio of Prestige properties covers residential, commercial, retail, hospitality and rental and resale segments. The Group posted a turnover of INR 3, 500 crore+ for FY15. The Group is spearheaded by Irfan Razack who holds office as its CMD and also his brothers Noaman and Rezwan Razack.

With regard to Prestige real estate projects, 192 projects have been completed by the Group which cumulatively cover more than 64.12 million sq. ft. and there are around 65 ongoing projects which span 67 million sq. ft. in all. There are 34 upcoming projects as well which collectively cover 41.38 million sq. ft. of top class realty space. The Group has its own interior designing outfit which is called the Morph Design Company (MDC) and has successfully built major residential townships, landmark shopping malls, tech parks, luxury villas, hotels, SEZs and luxury villas alike.

The Group has the largest mall in Chennai, namely the Forum Vijaya Mall to its credit in addition to several other landmark projects. The Group has also introduced reputed international brands to South India including Marriott International, Hilton Group, Oakwood, Banyan Tree and more. The Group has launched The Aloft at the Cessna Business Park in partnership with Starwood Hotels & Resorts Worldwide and will also be launching the Sheraton Hotel in the future. The Prestige Group is primarily based in Bangalore and is the only developer in the city to receive the coveted FIABCI award for residential and software facilities. Prestige is India’s sole CRISIL DA1 rated Developer and has also earned the ICRA A-financial rating.

Why Prestige?

Prestige Developers continually aims at exceeding customer expectations and setting new quality benchmarks. Prestige Realty is known for its emphasis on transparency, innovation and upgraded systems and processes. The Group believes in total transparency in all communication with customers and there are no hidden clauses or other legal loopholes that customers have to encounter. The Group counts immense experience, industry recognition and its solid track record as key USPs.

All Prestige residential projects are developed with the help of cutting edge technology and are also environment friendly and sustainable. The Group believes in impeccable project planning, development and management. The Quality Management System of the Group adheres to ISO 9001: 2000 guidelines and also ensures optimum value for the investments made by clients. The Group adopts best practices for safe, timely and reliable construction of projects and keeps construction wastage to a nondescript 5%. The Group believes in continually garnering customer feedback and developing projects based on the same.

Major Projects

There are several landmark Prestige projects that have earned both critical acclaim as well as customer appreciation over the years. Some of these include the following-

  • Prestige Acropolis- One of Bangalore’s earliest premium residential projects, this pays an awe inspiring tribute to classical Greek design and architecture
  • Prestige Golfshire- The first golf villa development in South India that is set against the majestic Nandi Hills and spans 275 acres. There is an 18 hole championship sized golf course in addition to a luxury spa, private lake and the Marriott International hotel among other attractions
  • Forum Mall- Kicked off Bangalore’s mall revolution and is arguably the city’s first successful retail destination
  • Prestige Shantiniketan- The first fully integrated township project in South India
  • Prestige Lakeside Habitat- This is the biggest development by the company and offers a whopping 3, 428 apartments and 271 villas over 102 acres. This project offers Disney themed residences to residents.

Whitefield, first settled in 1882 as a community for the Eurasians and Anglo Indians of Bangalore, remained a charming little community on the city's eastern outskirts until the late 1990s. It is when the local IT industry transformed into a significant suburb. It now makes up a sizable portion of Greater Bangalore. Whitefield is the first technology corridor in Bengaluru to have a Namma Metro connection.

The locality is a significant IT hub with hundreds of IT companies, tech parks, and businesses. The region provides employment opportunities to people from across the nation and the world. People who work in IT parks located in the area and along the IT corridor of the Outer Ring Road (ORR) prefer to live in Whitefield. EPIP Zone, International Tech Park, Sigma Tech Park, GR Tech Park, and other renowned technology parks are in the region or nearby.

Fortunately, the locality is nestled in proximity to the primary routes that connect the region with the rest of the city, such as Whitefield Main Road, SH-35, Old Airport Road, and Whitefield Railway Station. Whitefield can be proud of its high-quality social and retail infrastructure, which includes schools, hospitals, and entertainment places.

A bustling town, Whitefield is home to many business owners and professionals in the workforce. Due to its wide, well-paved roads and superior connectivity to other parts of Bangalore, the neighbourhood is a great choice for commuters and leisure travellers.

Whitefield has seen a boom in residential development from the latter half of the 1990s, especially from 2002 and so on. To accommodate the various demands of its residents, the area has a wide range of housing options, from more affordable apartments to more luxurious homes. Whitefield's real estate market has greatly grown, making it a popular place for investors and homeowners.

Whitefield residents have easy access to a wide variety of amenities. Locals can easily shop daily thanks to the region's abundance of stores, malls, and supermarkets.

What's Not Great About Whitefield?

The locality caters to multiple IT hubs in close vicinity.

It has robust connectivity to prime roads.

The Whitefield Key Road, SH-35, Old Airport Road, and Whitefield Railway Station are the key routes that connect the neighbourhood to the rest of the city.

Additionally, the Purple Metro Line will be extended from Baiyappanahalli to Whitefield, covering 13 stations, as part of Phase 2 of Namma Metro, and will provide metro access to Whitefield by 2023. When the extension work is finished, this line will link Whitefield in the east and Kengeri in the west. The availability of essential services, such as markets, healthcare, education, and, notably, business parks that offer excellent employment possibilities in the vicinity, significantly impacts a community's quality of life.

Old Madras Road

Famously known as OMR, it is one of the oldest roads since the 16th century. This prominent road links with the city's suburbs and is always bustling with trade. Thus, it has an upscale housing belt, as the road is a key route that connects Bangalore with Chennai.

Locals and visitors commonly comment on Whitefield's vibrant neighbourhood markets as one of its most notable features. Additionally, people have given a 4.2 out of 5 rating for traffic, parking, public commuting, and transportation. Considering all the key aspects, the overall rating of Whitefield is 4.6 out of 5.

How to Visit Whitefield?

Whitefield, a disciplined neighbourhood in Bangalore's eastern outskirts, is easily accessible from many different areas of the city. Here is the definitive guide to visiting Whitefield:

By Air - The closest airport to Whitefield is Kempegowda International Airport, 36.3 km from Bangalore. From the airport, one can take a taxi or cab to Whitefield.

By Train -Whitefield and Belandur Road Railway Station are separated by 8.4 km. It is one of Bellandur's busiest train stations, with many links to neighbouring cities, and serves as a major centre for passenger and freight transit. You can take an auto-rickshaw, a cab, or a taxi to travel to Whitefield from the station.

By Road - Car access to Whitefield is made possible through a well-kept road network. Bellandur Road and MG Road are significant road networks connecting Bangalore to Whitefield. Additionally, nearby cities and states have privately owned and operated buses.

Local Transport - The city offers a variety of transport options, including metro, cabs, city buses, auto-rickshaws, cycle-rickshaws and taxi services that can be reserved through an app. If you wish to see the city at your own pace, rent a car or a bike from one of the city's rental agencies.

Places to Visit in Whitefield

Lalbagh Botanical Garden

Since 1840, the garden has been a part of Bangalore. It is most well-known for its Green House, which features rare tropical trees, exotic plants worldwide, and fragrant and medicinal plants. It is well-liked by bird watchers because it also features a lake.

Jagriti Theater

Various plays, musicals, and other cultural events are presented in Whitefield's well-known performing arts venue, the Jagriti Theatre. Theatre lovers must visit because of its renowned compact setting and top-notch productions.

Cubbon Park

One of Bangalore's most beautiful tourist destinations is Cubbon Park, which is close to Whitefield. A stunning variety of sculptures like the Attara Kacheri (Karnataka's building of High Court) and a renowned statue of Queen Victoria, who declared the park open in 1891, can all be marvelled at by visitors.

Additionally, Cubbon Park comprises several lakes ideal for picnics or relaxing in the peace and quiet. All things considered, this is a fantastic opportunity to enjoy nature away from Bangalore's bustling city life. This is the most frequently visited attraction near Whitefield, Bangalore.

Locality Comparison

Considerations for comparing Whitefield to other Bangalore neighbourhoods include employment opportunities, road connectivity, safety measures, and other infrastructure aspects. Whitefield is directly connected to the main city alongside a booming social infrastructure which includes entertainment zones, shopping centres and different eateries.

Compared to other regions of Bangalore, Whitefield also holds the captivating old-word charm through its temples and historical monuments. For instance, Kali Temple, Shani Temple, Ganpati Temple, Bangalore Palace, and Cubbon Park are widely known. The locality offers a cosmopolitan lifestyle comparable to those in larger cities. The region has expansive malls, restaurants, cafes, and pubs which cater to the vibrant nightlife in the area.

Whitefield, in comparison, manages to combine corporate loudness and suburban tranquillity. Due to its established infrastructure and easy access to essential services, the area is well-liked. However, other locations could offer advantages like modern amenities, opulent housing, employment prospects, or proximity to specific institutions or commercial hubs.

Wrapping Up

Bangalore's Whitefield is a bustling neighbourhood that skillfully balances corporate confusion with historical charm. It features technology parks and IT hubs with reputed physical and social infrastructure. The locality has strong connectivity throughout the city and is near major roads. This locale facilitates green places and historical monuments with all the necessary modern facilities. Despite heavy traffic, congested parking, and busy roads on weekends, Whitefield receives good livability, connectivity, and safety remarks. The area's technology hub allures professionals from afar, a key point that promises high ROI for those who invest in the locality.
